note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. The board is a 50.8 mm circle centred on (125.4, 125.4). Tabs sit only where all copper is at least 0.55 mm from the edge (checked over +-1.75 mm along the edge), and not at the USB-C end (bottom), the switch (upper right) or the LiPo connector (lower left).
